title: Electrical Power — Primary Distribution Centre — Replace the Forward Contactor Modules with the Latching Standard

ata.title: Electrical Load Distribution — Primary Distribution Centre

abstract: Retrofit of the three latching contactor modules in the forward primary distribution centre, removing the fleet's dependence on a coil family that the supplier has given notice on and cutting the standing electrical load.

sections.planning_reason: The coil family used in the original forward primary distribution centre contactors is out of production and the last-time-buy quantity does not cover the delivered fleet to end of life. Thirty-one unscheduled removals in thirty months were attributed to contact erosion on the same coil. Aircraft that are not converted will face increasing spares lead times from 2019 and eventually a no-spares condition. There is no airworthiness concern: a failed contactor is annunciated and the distribution architecture is redundant.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives the instructions to remove the three original contactor modules from the forward primary distribution centre and to install the latching modules and their auxiliary contact blocks in their place. An interface bracket is installed at the two outboard positions to take up the additional module depth, and the mounting screws are renewed at every position. The status wiring at the two rack terminations is re-terminated on the new contact block. No change is made to the rack bus bar, to the feeder cables or to the distribution centre structure. The identification plates are replaced so that the rack standard can be established without removing a module.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Put the aircraft on external power removed and safety the distribution centre in accordance with the local procedure. Open the forward avionics bay access and remove the rack front cover. Remove the three contactor modules using AMM-T-24-50-11-000-001-A, and retain the modules for return. Install the interface bracket at the two outboard positions. Install the three latching modules and their auxiliary contact blocks using AMM-T-24-50-11-400-001-A, torquing the mounting screws to the value given in that task. Re-terminate the status wiring on the new contact blocks. Replace the rack identification plates. Restore the rack front cover and close the access. Restore electrical power and do the distribution centre functional test called out in the installation task. Record the modification in the aircraft technical log and update the configuration record.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to TITAN-88 aircraft in the MSN T00001 to T00113 range, excluding MSN T00073 which was converted on the line. The forward rack is the only rack in scope; the aft rack and the secondary distribution boxes are unaffected by this bulletin.
sections.material_note: Kit K2450-1105-01 covers one aircraft and has been available since March 2017. The removed modules must be returned; they carry a core value and the coils are recovered. No long-lead item. Sealant and identification plate material are operator-supplied.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled A-check, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
